An '''Elom''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carreras Major]] sometime in [[138 ABY]]. The [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] was accused of stealing something and while pleading for innocence, the Elom was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Carreras Major security force|security officer]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
